title: jmap-server: ScopedState<T> and ScopeGate (feature scoped-state)
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C4. Crates: jmap-server (scoped_state.rs, Cargo.toml). Size: M.

Implement docs/design/conditional.md §7 (conditional-02 §4, §6.1, §6.2). New feature scoped-state (enables tokio sync). ScopedState<T: Clone + Send>: async lock() waits on the gate unless the current task owns the open scope (reads too), lock_unscoped() for sync/seeding code; Arc<ScopeGate> (tokio Mutex) per backend by default, with_gate() to share one gate across backends; open(req, validate) takes the gate, records owner, snapshots T (Isolated may skip), returns Box<dyn SetScope> whose rollback/drop restores the snapshot synchronously and whose Atomic commit runs validate(&before,&after) -> Vec<DeferredFailure> first; deferring() for per-object methods. Can run in parallel with C3 (both add lib.rs mod/re-export lines; regenerate snapshot at merge). Acceptance: §10 ScopedState tests (unscoped read and write block while another task holds a scope; owner re-entry no deadlock; two backends on one shared gate no deadlock; rollback restores state and change log; drop rolls back; no scope opened -> lock never waits); rustdoc marks it demonstration quality; public-api additions only.
